title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: Show HN: Open-source vulnerability scanner
description: New tool automatically scans dependencies for known vulnerabilities and suggests patches. Gaining traction in the security community.

title: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save...
description: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions, which are protected only by a generic nonce that other  commonly expose on the front end, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to update arbitrary blog options such as the default role and open registration, and gain administrator access when such a  is active.

title: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before...
description: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before allowing a user to store popup preview data against arbitrary posts, nor restrict who can read that content back on public requests, allowing users granted access to the Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 to disclose the private and draft content of posts they do not own to unauthenticated visitors.

title: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before...
description: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it server-side and storing the fetched response so that it can be read back, allowing users with Administrator privileges to perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks and read the responses of internal services.

title: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the...
description: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the visitor's capabilities before rendering a popup requested by its ID in the URL, allowing unauthenticated users to read the content and configuration of popups that are still drafts or are marked private.

title: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup...
description: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute before it is reflected into a page and evaluated client-side, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the session of any higher-privileged user, such as an administrator, who views the affected content.

title: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling...
description: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it and printing it back into the pages a popup loads on, allowing users who are allowed to manage popups (an ability that can be delegated to lower-privileged roles) to inject JavaScript that executes in the browser of every visitor, including logged-in administrators.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen()...
description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files. Attackers can supply overlong quoted text values decoded into a 10,000-byte stack array during convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile calls, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows...
description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an overlong MD5 value in a crafted backup file. Attackers can overwrite adjacent phonebook and calendar entry pointers via strcpy() into MD5Original when files are loaded with convertbackup or restore, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in...
description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in backtext.c that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying long text fields. Attackers can craft a backup with long calendar or note fields that, when converted with gammu convertbackup, writes hex digits past the 10,000-byte stack buffer.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString(...
description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via oversized encoded phonebook text. Attackers can supply a crafted backup restored with gammu restore or addnew to an attached Alcatel phone, using GSM extension characters to crash Gammu or potentially execute code.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows...
description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS settings entries. Attackers can supply a backup with more than four TitleNN keys in a [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] section, loaded via convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious...
description: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a heap buffer by sending response bodies larger than 2 GB. When a user browses to an attacker-controlled HTTP, FTP, or gopher server, the oversized body skips reallocation and corrupts the heap, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

title: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that...
description: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious sierra-protocol camera or USB device overwrite stack memory. When files are listed, the device can answer the file-name register with an oversized packet, writing up to 32 KB past small stack buffers to cause crashes or possible code execution.

title: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious...
description: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.

title: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect...
description: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop that allows Contributor-level attackers to read non-public post type entries. Attackers can set the postTypes or queryPostType block attributes to types like flamingo_inbound or shop_coupon to expose titles and text, while the Atomic Wind custom_field path also leaks protected post meta.

title: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side...
description: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Contributor-level attackers to make the server contact arbitrary hosts via crafted Mailchimp API keys. Attackers can POST to the otter/v1/form/editor REST route with an apiKey whose data-center segment embeds a host, following redirects to internal services and reading partial responses.

title: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious...
description: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious IRR servers to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted A<len> replies. Attackers controlling the IRR server or tampering with the plaintext TCP connection can announce a ULONG_MAX or -1 length, wrapping the allocation to one byte and crashing bgpq4.

title: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows...
description: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course members to access other tenants' newsfeed posts by supplying a foreign feedId under their own courseId. Attackers can read, react to, and comment on cross-organization posts, while team members or org admins can also overwrite content, pin flags, and delete them.

title: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**)...
description: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**) patterns are compiled without the dotAll flag and fail to match line terminators. Attackers who control file, object key or archive entry names containing newline characters can evade ** deny patterns, causing excluded resources to be included and exposed.

title: Kestra before 1.3.36 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows...
description: Kestra before 1.3.36 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting HTML into the executions page sort parameter. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted link whose invalid sort value is rendered unsanitized in an error toast, stealing the non-HttpOnly BASIC_AUTH credential cookie to take over the instance.

title: CVE-2026-19793 - The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versio
description: The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.32 via the 'comment' parameter. This is due to a two-stage shortcode check that evaluates the raw mapping placeholder before data substitution, causing the neutralizer to be skipped when attacker-controlled comment content containing a malicious [wpie_function] shortcode is substituted at runtime. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP callables on the server. Exploitation requires an Administrator to perform the standard Export With Settings For Import followed by a New Import migration workflow, which is a routine operational task; the attacker themselves requires no account or authentication, needing only the ability to submit a pending comment on any comments-open post.

title: CVE-2026-131651 - The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-B
description: The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'media_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.7.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The vulnerability is only triggerable via the Backbone.js-rendered "Load More" pagination path; the server-side PHP gallery rendering correctly escapes media_title with esc_attr() and is not affected.
